title: Remove a student from a class

steps.say: **Remove** at the end of a student's row takes that pupil off this roster. It is per pupil, so you are always removing the person you are looking at.
It asks you to confirm before anything happens, which is your chance to check you are on the right row.
The student keeps their account and everything they have learned, and can join another class straight away. Only their place on this roster goes.
steps.terminal: That's removing a student — one row, one confirmation, nothing lost. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
